## Description {#details}

<p>A set of symbols and the their dependencies.</p>


<p>Used to describe dependencies for the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/orc/materializationresponsibility/#ae3a8d9b6fd3d07c66e5992645636cc9b">MaterializationResponsibility::notifyEmitted</a> operation.</p>
